chunks: "The share is one out of six."

key_terms.السَّهْمَ: A designated share or allotted portion in legal division.
key_terms.مِنْ سِتَّةٍ: Out of six parts; meaning one-sixth.

ai.seo_question: In Shia fiqh, what does a "share" (sahm) mean in a bequest of wealth?
ai.summary: This report gives a legal definition of the term "share" in the context of bequests and estate division. It states that a سهم refers to one-sixth, providing a concise rule for understanding fractional allotments in fiqh discussions.
